caption:
232 apartments are planned at Sixth and Sabine in downtown Austin.

On November 23, Sunrise Realty Trust announced it had closed its $31 million share of a $93 million construction loan for The Grant. The plans for 512 Sabine Street call for 232 apartments and about 8,235 square feet of ground-floor retail. Ryan Companies is developing and building the project.

The financing is a step toward adding rental homes near Waterloo Greenway. The announcement gave no date for leasing or move-ins.

Source: Sunrise Realty Trust, November 23, 2026.
